Applicants must pay the required application fee during entrance exam registration.

After entrance results are declared, candidates must complete the RGU Itanagar admission form on the Samarth portal by registering, entering academic details, uploading scorecards, and paying the counselling fee.
The university prepares a course-wise merit list based on CUET scores (UG/PG), candidate category, and seat availability. For PhD programs, shortlisting is based on RGUPET scores.

Shortlisted candidates must pay the RGU counselling fee of INR 300 and participate in counselling process, which includes document verification, seat allotment based on merit, payment of admission fees, and confirmation of the allotted seat.
